tests.description: Paired per-fold sign test: no_repulsion vs calibrated held-out rollout ADE (loco, n=26 folds)
tests.note: arm contrast for the ch06 held-out-ADE claim (thesis cross-cut review M3): per-arm-vs-real significance does not imply a significant ARM DIFFERENCE, so the difference is tested directly. LOCO folds share ~96% of training clips (refit overlap), so the fold pairs are not independent and the p reads anti-conservative.
